d:
The Magic defeated the Bucks, 107-99 tonight in Orlando. Franz Wagner contributed a team-high 35 points to go with 12 assists 9 rebounds and 3 three pointers, with Desmond Bane of the Magic adding an additional 21 points (7-13 FG, 6-10 3P) in the game. Jaime Jaquez Jr. finished with a team-high 22 points along with 6 rebounds for the Bucks in the losing effort. The Magic improve their record to 5-7 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-12 for the season.
